pickup_terminal_capacity_checks.explanation_plain: The second ending P098 retains the two-quarter closing material and continues into the printed Adagio figure in the same bounded bar. Its complete printed extent is four quarters: initial quarter; dotted eighth rest plus sixteenth; two groups of eighth plus sixteenth rest plus sixteenth. Pair the opening P083 with the first two closing quarters, and retain the additional two written quarters; no new barline separates the Adagio.

Variation V opens with a complete four-quarter P099 and has a complete four-quarter first ending P106. Its second ending P107 is two quarters (quarter plus quarter rest), immediately followed by the two-quarter pickup P108 of the next repeat section. The latter adjoining halves total four; do not invent a short P099.

P108 pickup and first ending P116 each contain two quarters and complement the four-quarter meter. The second ending P117 is intentionally longer: a half note tied to a quarter plus a quarter rest in violin, with a full four-quarter piano figure. Retain its full four-quarter capacity rather than forcing it to the shorter first ending.
The two-quarter closing P121 (quarter and quarter rest under fermata) precedes the two-quarter Tempo primo pickup P122 (four eighths); the adjoining halves total four.
